_note: Settings of the reported runs (R5 retrieval, both judges). run_code_sha256 identifies the code that produced the results; released_code_sha256 is the cleaned code in code/ (see README, 'Changes from the run code').
verdict_rule: Compliant only if evidence was assessed, every assessor vote is YES (coverage threshold 1.0), the evidence gate did not fire, and the contrastive verifier listed the target control; see scripts/reproduce_tables.py, verdict().

retrieval.kept_per_control: top 6 against the control text, plus top 3 per evidence query
retrieval.context_per_sentence: section heading, list lead-in, up to 900 characters of the provision
retrieval.queries_per_control: English control text, fixed Indonesian translation, up to 8 Indonesian element queries, 4 evidence queries
retrieval.evidence_queries: queries/hyde_queries_v5.json (written once by gemma4:31b, temperature 0); own-query runs use queries/hyde_queries_v5_gptoss.json
retrieval.section_expansion: 2 sections with the closest mean sentence embedding per evidence query, up to 25 sentences each

safeguards.evidence_gate: Not Compliant if the top reranker score among the evidence passed to the judge is below 0.15 (GROUNDING_THRESHOLD in code/main.py), unless a sentence added by control-specific keyword matching scores above 0.05 (FORCED_CE_MINIMUM); in the reported runs the exception applied only to SecureNusantara A.6.2. The value was chosen on the nine development companies, without a systematic search, to block almost no controls designed as implemented, and was never changed.
safeguards.contrastive_verifier: the judge model, given the full Annex A catalog, must list the target control as established (VERIFY_MODE=annexa; recorded, applied when scoring)

pipeline_options._note: Environment of the runs. The gate and verifier outcomes were recorded (GATE_MODE=assess, VERIFY=record) and applied when scoring (gate on, verifier applied), as in scripts/reproduce_tables.py.

judges.other: no seed; no context-length (num_ctx) or output-token (max_tokens) limit sent, so the service's unreported limits applied; 180 s request timeout; up to 6 retries with exponential backoff
judges.digests: not exposed for cloud-served models; served versions may change, and run dates record when runs took place, not which versions were served

run_dates.government_document_repeats: 2026-11-07 to 2026-11-08 (two repeats per judge, same cached evidence and code)
run_dates.constructed_corpus_rerun_620_controls: seven constructed companies judged a second time on the same evidence; its date and raw files are not part of this package (summary figures only, paper Section IV-F)
run_dates._source: timing logs of each run (results/run_times.csv for the constructed corpus and public sets)

inputs._note: Corpora as judged in the reported runs. scripts/prepare_inputs.py and the code/ingest_*.py scripts rebuild them; compare the SHA-256 of each segmented corpus file. All corpus files have CRLF line endings, which the ingest scripts write on every platform.
